description: Search Norwegian public-transport stops, train stations, tram/metro/bus stops, ferry quays and places by name via the Entur national stop-register geocoder. Returns official name, NSR id (usable in entur_departures and entur_journey), locality, categories, transport modes, and coordinates. Example: entur_stops_search({ query: "Trondheim" })

query.description: Place or stop name to search, e.g. "Trondheim", "Nationaltheatret"

name: entur_stops_search
